summary: Held through a strongly favorable, choppy uptrend (0 to +150+ pts) as long as ER10 stayed elevated and turn-detector fires (KMDR/HA/CLIMAX/PROPP) were mixed or isolated single-frame events -- prior pullbacks like frame 9 and frame 13 recovered to new highs, so single against-fires were treated as noise. Exited when price broke sharply (~40pts in one step) off a 3-frame stable plateau near +150 with all three detectors (KMDR, HA, PROPP) unanimously against for two consecutive frames and ER10 fading -- that multi-frame confirmed cluster after a plateau, rather than a single fire mid-trend, was the exit trigger. Next time I'd watch for that same signature (plateau + multi-frame unanimous against + ER10 rollover) earlier, and pre-define how large a single-step giveback from a plateau justifies acting on one fire instead of waiting for confirmation.
